research_goal: Empirically test whether shared Focusa cognitive primitives and UIAI observation/actuation improve source-verified task outcomes and continuity across heterogeneous domains without transferring private state or domain truth ownership.
role: Optional secondary study following the mandatory initial Spec 114 18-task on/off benchmark; adds domain transfer and continuous-operation challenges without replacing initial benchmark or committing to fixed domain count.
baseline_policy: Compare same underlying model, agent, available tasks, domain source access, budget and equivalent actuator capabilities. Measure incremental Focusa, UIAI and their interaction only when each alternative adapter supports a comparable feasible action. Fail as incomparable otherwise.

duration_tests.synthetic_clock: fast simulated event-time to test invariants; must not be reported as uptime
duration_tests.continuous_wallclock: one real monitored 24-hour fixture-only run on authorized infrastructure; sampled heartbeat and missed trigger metrics; never live trading
